nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ that has neither $K_5$ nor $K_{3,3}$ as a minor, and let $\ell$ assign a natural number $\ell(u, v)$ to every ordered pair of vertices $u, v$ such that $u$ and $v$ are adjacent in $G$ if and only if $u \ne v$ and $\ell(u, v) > 0$. Then $G$ has a proper vertex coloring with four colors.
nodes.title: Four color theorem

nodes.summary: A simple graph $G$ has $K_{3,3}$ as a minor if there are six nonempty, pairwise disjoint sets of vertices $L_1, L_2, L_3, R_1, R_2, R_3$ such that any two vertices in the same set are joined by a walk in $G$ all of whose vertices lie in that set, and for all $i, j \in \{1, 2, 3\}$ some vertex of $L_i$ is adjacent in $G$ to some vertex of $R_j$.
nodes.title: Graphs with a $K_{3,3}$ minor

nodes.summary: A simple graph $G$ has $K_5$ as a minor if there are five nonempty, pairwise disjoint sets of vertices $S_1, \dots, S_5$ such that any two vertices in the same set are joined by a walk in $G$ all of whose vertices lie in that set, and for all distinct $i, j$ some vertex of $S_i$ is adjacent in $G$ to some vertex of $S_j$.
nodes.title: Graphs with a $K_5$ minor

nodes.summary: A simple graph $G$ is called planar here if it has neither $K_5$ nor $K_{3,3}$ as a minor.
nodes.title: Planarity by forbidden minors

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
